cādhammenadhīyatī.l: Yo cāyaṁ mantaṁ vāceti, yo cādhammenadhīyatī
cādhammenadhīyatī.g: , evaṁ brāhmaṇañca rājānañca ubhopi adhammikabhāve ṭhapesi.

cādhammenadhīyati.l: Yo cāyaṁ mantaṁ vāceti, yo cādhammenadhīyatī
cādhammenadhīyati.g: , evaṁ brāhmaṇañca rājānañca ubhopi adhammikabhāve ṭhapesi.

caddhagū.g: yasmā dukkhānupatitabhāvopi dukkho addhagūbhāvopi, tasmā vaṭṭasaṅkhātaṁ addhānaṁ gamanatāya addhagū na bhaveyya, vuttappakārena dukkhena anupatitopi na bhaveyyāti attho.

caddhagu.g: yasmā dukkhānupatitabhāvopi dukkho addhagūbhāvopi, tasmā vaṭṭasaṅkhātaṁ addhānaṁ gamanatāya addhagū na bhaveyya, vuttappakārena dukkhena anupatitopi na bhaveyyāti attho.
